# A cabbage: a faceted head in a ring of four broad outer leaves. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.22 --location 0 0 0.2
material new Heart --base-color 0.310 0.467 0.329
material assign Heart
add mesh cone --name Leaves --vertices 5 --radius1 0.42 --radius2 0.18 --depth 0.24 --cap-fill none --location 0 0 0.12 --rotation 0 0 18
material new Leaf --base-color 0.227 0.376 0.290
material assign Leaf
select all
shade flat
export cabbage.glb
